content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization, information, or medical-necessity issue, so retro-authorization, records, peer-to-peer, and a necessity appeal do not address the payer’s stated reason. No correctable coding or modifier detail is available, and blind resubmission risks another denial; a specialist must review the related paid service and applicable bundling edit before determining whether correction or an administrative appeal is appropriate."}
